name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.216.0 — A File Plan row on the new baseline layer names a file only the built product can produce and a person approves (a screenshot baseline): the build no longer demands it at TESTS or in a wave, and refuses the integrated mark until it exists, so the approval lands before the gate runs. The fleet evidence reader, run from inside a spec worktree, now scans the checkouts beside the main checkout instead of reporting zero repos. 7.215.0 — expire-tests.js --apply also removes a line-start describe( that held a retired test and is left with no test/it/describe token (nested ones inner-first), reported as emptiedSuites, so a retirement never leaves an empty suite vitest fails on; lib/scan-test-calls.js gains scanDescribes on the same opaque-span walk. 7.214.0 — walkthrough contract: the pushRound example's journey beats now hash its own two steps (f5eac39a8e33, was the four-step story's 08363cd98ef8) in request, response and the pullApprovals echo; a not-found 404 code names an unknown address under /v1 and raises revision to 2 (additive per compatibility); a contract-files test replays every example journey's beats against beatHash of its steps.
